svg.title: Sherlock Holmes rewrite experiment
svg.desc: 50 recorded rewrite attempts; gpt-5.6-sol; three training and three held-out passages.. Candidate drafts include rejected attempts. Retained drafts are selected using training measurements, not held-out results. Lower distance is not a percentage voice match.

g.text: 50 recorded rewrite attempts; gpt-5.6-sol; three training and three held-out passages.
Recorded outputs and measured scores; no benchmark copying or forced alignment.
Not measured: requires a spaCy English model. No match is implied.
